en.html:
Ichijou"Ek minute—BEACH HOLIDAY?! Kab tay hua yeh bakchodi?! Why the hell are WE swimming about as if this is perfectly normal?!"
Kanae"Oh, but what can one say to that?"
Sayo"Upon arrival, Miss Ayane, everyone was found enjoying midsummer in the most ordinary manner."
Ichijou"Unko mana kiya kya?! Let THEM enjoy their bloody holiday! Hum kyun—why have WE joined the bathing party?!"
Kageaki"Intelligence work begins by blending into the situation. One must not be the foreign element on the scene."
Sayo"A statement of real depth. I should like to read it aloud to a certain person who wears blackish clothes and a blackish aura at all hours, and stands out against every surrounding like a lump of charcoal dropped into milk."
Kageaki"Ji. Entirely."
Kanae"Does this man have even one symptom of self-awareness...?"
Ichijou"F-fine, blend! But swimsuit tak pahunch gaye?! Getting into swimsuits also became compulsory?!"
Kageaki"The only clothing sold in the nearby shops was swimwear. It could not be helped. To walk this shore in ordinary dress is reckless."
Kanae"We would be drenched in sweat."
Sayo"Time to dehydration, I estimate, is about ninety minutes."
Ichijou"Uuugh..."

en.html:
Kageaki"We cannot cross."
Ichijou"...Eh? Why not?"
Kageaki"I looked into it on the way here. At present, the whole of Enoshima is designated a prohibited zone."
Kageaki"The order is naturally the shogunate's. Reason unknown."
Ichijou"...Because of this so-called weapons research?"
Kageaki"It is possible."
Ichijou"So what do we do?"
Kageaki"If crossing openly is impossible, we cross not-openly. That is all. Finding the method is the second reason we are staying here."
Kageaki"The third is intelligence gathering. Ordinarily I dislike the roundabout method of asking around just before the destination."
Kageaki"This time is different."
Ichijou"...Yes. Before going to the island, at least we should know something about what this situation even is..."
Kageaki"Ji. As it stands, I have no wish to set foot in it."
Ichijou"It's summer, after all..."
Kageaki"It is summer..."

When I first heard the story at the shrine—and later, going over the intelligence while I explained it to Ichijou—I had been half doubtful about Rokuhara's dangerous research. If anything, I had leaned toward puzzlement.

Now that balance had reversed.

The shogunate was doing something on that island. Probably.
en.text:
When I first heard the story at the shrine—and later, going over the intelligence while I explained it to Ichijou—I had been half doubtful about Rokuhara's dangerous research. If anything, I had leaned toward puzzlement.

Now that balance had reversed.

The shogunate was doing something on that island. Probably.
